verdict: Yes, with a clear functional benefit. What's Up Wellness pitched wellness in the form of quick bites on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal from three sharks. Bite-sized snacks with added nutrition appeal to busy buyers, but claims must follow FSSAI rules.
angle: Energy bites, ladoos and bars with nuts, seeds and herbs are easy to eat on the go. Specific benefits such as energy, sleep or women's health help products stand out. Freshness and shelf life need careful testing.
